args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (production error rate reached 18% across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. The initial rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollback for us-west and eu-west. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error before attempting re-deploy.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed, due to an orchestrator error), but the retry succeeded — all three regions are now on v2.3.0, the service is **healthy**, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.

3. **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), and the recovery. The create request timed out on the initial call, but I verified via the incident list that it was actually created and open, so on-call has been paged once (no duplicate was created).
